label: PF Backlog 574
title: DECISION: define/review the contents of feature groups G1..G10 + their tier membership (currently only titles; not operator-approved)
body: The feature groups G1..G10 and the tier->group membership exist only as short TITLES in core/licensing.py::FEATURE_GROUPS and config/licensing-tiers.json (introduced by BI-0060). There is NO per-feature -> group mapping, and the operator has NOT reviewed/approved this mapping. Decision needed: define what each group contains (which real capabilities/APIs/screens) and confirm the tier->group membership + limits (seats/parallel projects) before it is treated as contractual.

objective: Operator-approved, versioned definition of the entitlement model: base 'Create Products' + add-ons, baseline security, internal-only set, per-tenant limits, tier ladder, and a versioning scheme (names/keys included).
acceptance_criteria: base 'Create Products' + add-ons + baseline security + internal-only set recorded
config/licensing-tiers.json + core/licensing.py reflect the v1.0 model (G-codes kept as aliases)
per-tenant hierarchy labelled: users(seats) -> projects -> parallel runs
A2 boundary gate uses a customer domain, not the (internal) worker
in_scope: config/licensing-tiers.json -> v1.0 schema (entitlement_model_version; groups as key+name+internal+legacy-alias; tiers; per-tenant limits)
core/licensing.py -> FEATURE_GROUPS shape; entled/entitlements accept new keys + keep G1..G10 aliases; internal groups never granted; model-version aware
test_licensing.py -> cover base + add-ons + aliases + internal-never-granted
out_of_scope: pricing; actual per-feature code removal; the A2 license crypto (done in BI-PF-0396)
approach: Record the v1.0 model; then implement in config/licensing-tiers.json (groups with key+name+internal flag + version) + core/licensing.py (FEATURE_GROUPS, entled/entitlements, enforce gate -> customer domain 'build-products'); keep G-codes as aliases; update the map doc; update tests.
verification: Objective achieved: DECISION: define/review the contents of feature groups G1..G10 + their tier membership (currently only titles; not operator-approved)
risks: renaming identifiers could break existing references (mitigate: keep G1..G10 aliases)
legacy dashboard imports licensing.FEATURE_GROUPS (frozen) -> keep back-compat shape
code/doc drift (mitigate: doc cites config; add a consistency check if cheap)
versioning must be embedded so old licenses map to the version they were issued under
summary: Entitlement model v1.0 (customer-centric, versioned). BASE 'Create Products' (every paid tier): Build Products (generation engine/workspace); Ideate & Design; Assure Quality; Plan & Deliver. ADD-ONS: Team Size, Projects & Parallel Runs (scale); Team & Multi-Tenancy; Choose Your AI Models; Create Content & Media; Automate with AI Agents; Launch & Grow; Integrate & Extend; Advanced Compliance. BASELINE (all tiers): Security. INTERNAL-ONLY (never customer tiers): worker/orchestration internals; PF's own improvement work (pf-intake); Platform Ops & Licensing. LIMITS per tenant: users(seats) -> projects(created) -> parallel runs. LADDER: trial=base+tiny scale; starter=+Integrate & Extend; pro=+Team & Multi-Tenancy, Choose Your AI Models, Create Content & Media, Automate with AI Agents; enterprise=+Launch & Grow, Advanced Compliance, unlimited. VERSIONING: entitlement_model_version embedded in licenses + editions; renames are new versions. Internal aliases: legacy G1..G10 retained as aliases for compatibility.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/context_review.py, core/cross_review.py, core/multi_model_review.py, core/rerun_review.py
